sections.overview:
1. 整体市场概况和情绪

今日主要事件：

  • The “earnings blowout = stock price collapse” phenomenon entered its third day, with the damage spreading from memory to AI compute. SNDK closed Wednesday at 1302.02 (-8.83%). Q4 revenue of $8.97 billion and EPS of $39.25 (vs. $34.45 expected) both beat estimates, but the midpoint of next quarter’s revenue guidance fell below consensus and gross margin declined sequentially. WDC closed at 465.44 (-15.12%); revenue rose 43.8% YoY, EPS beat estimates by nearly 8%, and next-quarter guidance was 1.5% above consensus, yet the stock was still crushed—the market attributed the move to profit-taking after a 585% gain over 12 months. AMD closed at 481.84 (-8.31%), with record revenue of $11.5 billion and data center revenue up 107%, but was held back by a 54% gross margin versus 56% expected due to Helios ramp-up costs.
  • SPCX lockup expiration day has arrived. The stock closed Wednesday at 107.97 (-14.28%). Today, 911.5 million shares, worth approximately $116 billion, will unlock, though only the first 20% can be sold on the first day. Another 455.8 million shares are subject to conditional release, Musk and core insiders remain locked up until mid-2027, and the 180-day tranche will not be fully released until December 8. The company reported Q2 revenue of $7.8 billion, up 92% YoY and above expectations.
  • The South Korean stock market triggered another circuit breaker on Thursday Korean time, with the KOSPI closing down approximately 4.6% at 6,296, led lower by Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix. The main driver remained skepticism over returns on AI capital expenditure. The “-8%” figure circulating in the community was an emotionally exaggerated claim.
  • The Strait of Hormuz agreement is stuck in the “last mile.” Iran said the draft shipping-lane agreement with Oman had entered its final stage and was awaiting approval from the Supreme Leader, while Trump again hinted that an announcement would come this week. However, an Iranian spokesperson added that “even if an understanding is reached, it does not mean the strait will be safe for all vessels.” Oil prices cooled, with USO closing at 114.90 (-0.73%). Safe-haven and reflation expectations eased simultaneously: GLD +4.14%, SLV +4.14%, and GDX +7.13%, while silver briefly broke above $62 intraday to reach a new monthly high.
  • Small-cap earnings were sharply polarized: SOUN traded at 7.05 after hours (+8.21%) after Q2 revenue of $61.9 million (+45%) beat expectations and full-year guidance was raised to $230–260 million. NuScale (SMR) reported only $100,000 in Q2 revenue, down 98.8% YoY, and closed at 8.92 (-6.01%). At the index level, divergence continued: DIA +0.43%, while QQQ -0.91% and IWM -0.64%; SPY was essentially flat at 770.60.

社区氛围：一种结合了极度困惑和麻木的看跌氛围——不是恐慌性抛售，而是一种“规则不再有效”的疲惫感。社区反复询问为什么利润翻倍的公司的股价却下跌了一半，然后用笑话、肮脏的幽默和打油诗回避了这个问题。与此同时，一小群人在拥挤的 SPCX 空头和 SOUN 的高空头兴趣中寻找逆势机会。

恐惧/贪婪程度：大约 35/100，表示恐惧，但并非失控。其特征是“个股恐慌，指数平静”——VIX仍然受到严重压制，许多人评论说，“指数看起来完全没问题，但你们都在尖叫。”真正的痛苦集中在内存和半导体持有者身上，许多用户披露了他们的成本基础——SNDK 为 2200，MU 为 1130，2 倍杠杆 ETF 和 5 倍杠杆——以及诸如“我再也不会碰期权”之类的投降式声明。

社区情绪与实际价格行为：明显不同。社区的说法是“明天崩溃/血洗/触底”，而 SPY 周三实际上仅下跌 0.07%，道琼斯指数上涨 0.43%。黄金、白银和矿业股创下本周最强单日表现。一些头脑清醒的网友指出：“标普涨了0.2%，你慌什么？”这种背离本身现在被社区用作反向指标——“WSB 一致看空 SPCX，所以它必须上涨。”
